title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Not asking for much, but I really want to make an appearance on the Talkin Tigers podcast this year
We can talk about how no one understands your jokes or sarcasm for all I care
Haha though it would be funny if every podcast I joined for two minutes to run down jokes you made that not enough people pick up on.
Emphasized “Haha though it would be funny if every podcast I joined for two minutes to run down jokes you made that not enough people pick up on.”
